packageRules.description: dsh packages publish real releases on the `next` dist-tag (latest is a placeholder 0.0.1-rc.1); track that channel and bump declared ranges so pre-release ranges keep matching across patch boundaries. Deliberately excludes @deepseek-ai/cordis and @deepseek-ai/schemastery: their `latest` is a real release (4.0.1 / 3.18.1) while `next` is an older prerelease, so following `next` there would downgrade them.

react is external in lib/client.js: at runtime the DSH host SPA provides React 18 (harness pins react ^18.2.0 / @types/react ~18.3.1). Upgrading locally would build against React 19 types while running on the host's React 18.

Hold TypeScript on the 6.x line to match the harness baseline (^6.0.3) instead of chasing latest. 7.0 is the native (Go) port: its bin drops tsserver and its package.json exposes no main/types, so the programmatic TypeScript API is gone — editors set to 'use workspace version' lose their language server, and rolldown-plugin-dts (pulled in by tsdown) needs that API as soon as dts is enabled. Still offers 6.x patch/minor.
